title: An angel with a sword over Jerusalem during the plague after David's census

tellings.quote: An angel stands [music] over Jerusalem with a drawn sword during the plague of David's census.

plain: In the Bible, after King David counts his people in a census and a plague follows, an angel is said to stand over Jerusalem with a drawn sword. Michels tells it himself from the Bible, in an episode about Air Force veterans who say they were abducted by aliens. He raises it as an ancient account of a powerful being appearing in the sky.
